verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-first card-issuing platform, for example bulk-issuing cards or bulk-updating spending controls. The evidence only documents single-object endpoints (create one Card, create one Cardholder), with no batch or bulk API, bulk Dashboard action, or bulk import. The MCP server and CLI are building blocks a developer could script loops with, not a bulk-operations capability, so they earn no credit.
